title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol to embed trust metrics directly into navigation, ensuring safe, verifiable AI movement in real-world environments.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking provides objective standards that NavTrust lacks—it’s impossible to measure trustworthiness without clear, repeatable metrics across diverse scenarios.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates ISO/IEC 23894 standards for AI trustworthiness, giving developers a concrete framework to evaluate and improve their systems in real-time.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking reveals flaws in NavTrust’s assumptions—without independent evaluation, any protocol is just a theoretical ideal, not a practical solution.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Trust without benchmarking is like a map without coordinates—useless in the real world.
